rows.why: Sources, citations, methods, and provenance markers are detectable with text rules.
Hedges, modal verbs, uncertainty terms, and preliminary-status language are countable.
Credibility, substantive value, and authenticity require semantic and external judgment.
Metrics, baselines, standards, targets, and governance disclosures support lexical scoring.
Clarity is measurable, but compliance requires legal and investor context.
Strategy and coherence depend on interpreting intent, response adequacy, and context.
Action verbs, responsible parties, timelines, and remedy categories are detectable.
Alignment requires comparing reality and other channels beyond the release.
Readability formulas, jargon lists, sentence structure, and accessibility cues are computable.
Promotional markers, sentiment, hype, and newsroom conventions are lexically approximable.
Scientific accuracy and causality require domain knowledge and external verification.
Authenticity and identity coherence require brand context beyond release wording.
Quality and usability require inspecting multimedia assets, not release text.
Quote value and authenticity require semantic interpretation and source verification.
Lede position, length, dates, entities, and 5W cue coverage are measurable.
Headline length, specificity, match, clickbait cues, and integrity proxies are measurable.
Headings, paragraphs, lists, links, whitespace, and sentence lengths are measurable.
Originality and newsworthiness require external comparison and editorial judgment.
Apology terms, responsibility admissions, and corrective actions are detectable.
Dates, times, locations, speakers, access details, and contacts are detectable.
Sensitivity requires cultural knowledge, historical context, and nuanced interpretation.
Lede placement, inverted ordering, information density, and 5W coverage are measurable.
Audience tailoring requires knowing intended readers and their needs.
Keywords, headings, entity prominence, repetition, and link text support discoverability proxies.
Numbers, units, comparisons, citations, and evidence phrases are detectable.
Limitation, caveat, uncertainty, and scope-qualification markers are countable.
Visualization design and usability cannot be assessed from text alone.
Boilerplate structure and organization, mission, history, and contact fields are detectable.
Grammar, consistency, spelling, style conventions, and formatting regularity are rule-checkable.
Targeting requires outlet identity, beat knowledge, and personalization context.
Disclosure phrases are detectable, but AI origin and integrity cannot be verified.
Availability is detectable; contact credibility requires external identity and trust checks.
Action verbs, next steps, deadlines, links, and contact pathways are detectable.
Logo usage and brand compliance require visual assets and brand guidelines.
Parties, transaction type, terms, dates, risks, and disclaimers are detectable.
Publication dates, times, time zones, and timestamp labels are directly measurable.
Acknowledgments are detectable, but co-branding compliance requires partner context.
Publish readiness requires inspecting attached assets and delivery completeness.
CONSORT adherence requires interpreting study-report content against an external checklist.
Outcomes, effect sizes, confidence intervals, p-values, and precision terms are detectable.
Scale proxies include quantities, locations, capacities, staffing, timelines, and rollout scope.
Incident facts, reassurance language, attribution, and factual-density contrasts are measurable.
First disclosure status requires knowing what was previously public.
Ecosystem implications require industry knowledge and broader contextual reasoning.
Celebrity names, humor cues, stunt language, and independent attribution are detectable.
Instructions, eligibility, deadlines, channels, and concrete user actions are detectable.
Named figures, cultural references, and crossover cues support lexical approximation.
Audience terms, geographic breadth, counts, and affected-population markers are measurable.
Filing terms, agencies, form names, legal verbs, and dates are detectable.
Drama, seriousness, and stakes require subjective interpretation beyond lexical severity cues.
Distinctiveness and access require narrative interpretation and external exclusivity context.
Urgency terms, deadlines, event dates, and recency cues are detectable.
Operational nouns, quantities, locations, procedures, owners, and timelines are countable.
5W1H coverage and self-contained detail can be rule-scored.
Conflict verbs, opposing parties, concessions, disputes, and attributed disagreement are detectable.
Non-routine status requires organizational and historical baseline context.
Structural scope requires industry-level interpretation and external context.
Artifact links, filenames, attachments, reports, datasets, and supporting documents are detectable.
External parties, impact verbs, beneficiaries, victims, and consequences are detectable.
Change of state requires comparing the announcement with prior standing information.
Independence requires source relationships, provenance, and external verification.
5W coverage, quotes, contacts, dates, assets, and facts support usability scoring.
Dates, named entities, locations, quantities, and event verbs are directly detectable.
Materiality and stakes require contextual judgment, despite measurable scale indicators.
Named accountable actors, admissions, commitments, and specific disclosures are detectable.
Attribution, direct-quote structure, concrete details, and candor markers are detectable.
Competitor names, comparison operators, metrics, units, and head-to-head phrasing are detectable.
